The lens that makes Rothschild look 'everywhere' makes it look smaller than eight named rivals once fees and values are used; the lens that makes it look 'nowhere' does the same to Lazard. Fees: undisclosed for every adviser on every side except the two Re 1 bids, which are Big Four, not Rothschild. JVs: Jio BlackRock, Bajaj Finserv, IIHL–Invesco and Nippon Life–RNAM were recorded with the same predicates (own, award, law) under the same reg. 7; the domestic control (Bajaj Finserv) waited the same 11 months for in-principle approval; the foreign-majority acquisitions (Nippon Life 75%, Invesco→IIHL 60%) went through change-in-control rather than a new licence, which is faster than either JV route. Persons: Ambani, Fink and Pandey were each recorded only by office with dates; none carries an allegation claim in this file.
